content:
**The five most‑recent Indian films that have either won an Oscar or been nominated for one (as of the 2023 ceremony) – together with their official running times**

| # | Film (year) | Oscar status | Running time (minutes) |
|---|-------------|--------------|------------------------|
| 1 | **RRR** (2022) | Nominated – Best International Feature Film (95th Oscars, 2023) | **182 min** |
| 2 | **The Elephant Whisperers** (2022) | Won – Best Documentary Short Film (95th Oscars, 2023) | **39 min** |
| 3 | **Lagaan** (2001) | Nominated – Best International Feature Film (74th Oscars, 2002) | **224 min** |
| 4 | **Salaam Bombay!** (1988) | Nominated – Best International Feature Film (61st Oscars, 1989) | **121 min** |
| 5 | **Mother India** (1957) | Nominated – Best International Feature Film (30th Oscars, 1958) | **189 min** |
